coding.notes: Affirmed in part, vacated in part, and remanded. The USPTO intervened and is not treated as a side. Appointments Clause challenge was withdrawn and waived, so it is not coded. Board applied broadest reasonable interpretation because petitions were filed before November 13, 2018.

issues.description: Correct HTSUS classification of imported sausage casings: whether the casings are classified as made-up textile articles under Chapter 63 (6307.90.98) or as plastic tubes under Chapter 39 (3917.39.0050), turning on whether the textile is 'completely embedded in plastics' under Chapter 59 Note 2(a)(3).
issues.quote: Accordingly, we affirm the Trade Court's decision to classify the casings under HTSUS subheading 6307.90.98.

coding.author: PER CURIAM
coding.notes: Per curiam opinion affirming the Court of International Trade's summary judgment for the government. Judge Hughes concurred separately, agreeing with the result but reading 'completely embedded in plastics' to require every fiber surface to be surrounded by plastic; no judge dissented. Sides defined as importer (Side A) and Government (Side B) per trade customs case type.

issues.description: Prejudgment interest rate: Rule 59(e) adjustment bifurcating the award into pre-suit Treasury rate and post-suit prime rate, favoring patent owner
